mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. Over by Verona Area High School, we have got overcast skies and a humid seventy-two degrees that feels more like seventy-five. Yes, it is sticky, but we will survive. In city news, local K through twelve students have until July twenty-second to submit their creative designs for the city's I Voted sticker contest. In police news, officers are looking for a motorcyclist who fled a traffic stop at high speed, blowing through red lights. Keep it safe out there, and treat yourself to today's delicious Culver's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
